*   `?g A14`: Main Concept (green pawn) is on A14 (Food / Eating / Edible).
    *   `+ F3`: Cube on F3 (Water / Liquid / Aquatic) in group `g`.
    *   `+ F1`: Cube on F1 (Hot / Day – Light / Sun) in group `g`.
    *   `!r A14`: Sub-Concept (red pawn) is on A14 (Food / Eating / Edible).
    *   `+ H9`: Cube on H9 (Hollow / Hole / Pierced) in group `r`.

    *   Main concept: Food.
    *   Qualities of the food (group `g`): Liquid and Hot.
    *   Related idea (group `r`): Food that is hollow or has a hole in it.

    *   Soup (Liquid, Hot, but not typically hollow/pierced).
